 These Black Friday streaming deals are some of the best we’ve seen yet, but make sure you read the fine print: Some are only open to new or returning subscribers, and others are for ad-supported plans, not ad-free ones. Still, they’re all worth checking out. 
 Also: Best early Black Friday deals 
 I’ve been reviewing streaming services for ZDNET and our sister site CNET for years, and these are my picks for the best Black Friday streaming deals so far that I’ll be tracking live through the holiday sale period — so you can finally join the conversation when your coworkers are discussing Widow’s Bay or The Gilded Age . Get them before they’re gone — they only come around once a year. We’ll continue to update this list as deals come and go.
 Best Black Friday streaming deals of 2026
 Apple/ZDNET 
 for $6.99/month for 6 months (save 53%) 
 Apple TV 
 Get it now 
 See at Amazon 
 Expert Take 
 Current price: $6.99/month for 6 months (53% off) 
 Original price: $14.99/month 
 Apple TV’s best deal of the year gives you six months of your subscription for $6.99 a month, down from the usual price of $14.99 a month. Like the HBO Max deal, you’ll need to get this one as an add-on to your Prime Video account to get the discount. You’ll have to cancel before the six months is up if you don’t want to then get charged full price, but that’s plenty of time to catch up on the streamer’s many award-winning shows, including Ted Lasso , Shrinking , Widow’s Bay , Severance , Slow Horses , The Morning Show , and Pluribus .

 This Disney+/Hulu bundle deal is technically not a Black Friday deal, since it’s usually available, but it’s still worth calling out if you’re looking to save on these services. In recent years, we’ve seen a bigger price drop on this bundle closer to Black Friday (last year it was $4.99 a month for the first year), so we’ll keep a lookout for that.

 Our favorite Fire TV stick gets a big discount for Black Friday. “This streaming stick is really fast for the money, delivering snappier performance than my older Fire TV Sticks and even my Fire TV Series 4,” ZDNET smart home reviewer Maria Diaz said of the Fire TV stick. It supports 4K TVs, so you can stream 4K content without issues, as well as HDR10+, Dolby Vision, and Dolby Atmos, as long as your TV and audio system do.
 Also: Roku TV vs. Fire Stick: Why I’m looking beyond streaming resolution when comparing the two 
 FAQs on Black Friday streaming deals
 Are streaming services really cheaper during Black Friday? 
 Often, yes. In recent years, we’ve seen the lowest prices of the year for subscriptions to Hulu, Paramount+, and more during Black Friday and Cyber Monday week. We’ve also seen some of the lowest prices of the year on streaming accessories, like Roku streaming sticks and Amazon Fire TV sticks.
